cases.name: reports an update only on a check, shows a member no digest, refuses a key and applies one pinned candidate with the data and grants kept
refuses a change prepared on an old schema or data revision from two tabs of two people and applies nothing
replays an operation ID as one receipt from every node, conflicts on a different request and never applies twice or under a new ID
settles a revocation that races a confirmation: one outcome, applied at most once, and no work after the revocation
separates owner, editor, viewer, administrator and stranger across the browser routes, the REST routes and the chat tool consumer
serves the browser module to every account with the feature and to nobody else, from the owner and each frontend
fails every blocked consumer explicitly and never serves add-on tools to it
is the administrator's own action on every node and never a key's, a member's or a tool's
refuses a corrupt backup and a restore that is not allowed, and leaves the data as it was
restores a verified backup: the data goes back, the add-on starts again and access follows the current accounts
denies the open tabs of a disabled add-on everywhere and serves them again, with the same data, when it is enabled
keeps data and grants when the add-on is removed and installed again, and refuses what the old generation prepared
denies the next call of a paused key on every node and accepts it again when resumed
denies the browser, the key and the chat everywhere when the add-ons feature is withdrawn
lowers an editor to a viewer for the next call everywhere and drops the proposals the editor still held
refuses the session and the key of a disabled account on every node
ignores actor, forwarding and authority headers and fields on every node
denies authority, role and approval fields in the arguments of every consumer and creates nothing
applies a proposal only on the confirmation of the proposer's own tab, with its digest, exactly once
keeps every acknowledged change and applies no change twice when the Tables process is killed in the middle of a batch
keeps every acknowledged change and applies no change twice when the owner is killed in the middle of a batch and restarted
blocks every other write while a confirmation is unresolved, keeps reading, and accepts writes again only after the owner role resolves it
fails every response type closed with the same typed answer from both frontends, runs nothing there and serves everything again after the restart
exports a CSV through a frontend and serves the same bytes from every node to its requester only
stops the downloads of a person whose access to the database was revoked, on every node, and keeps the owner's
denies downloads while the add-on is disabled and serves a complete file again when it is enabled
